proposals.evidence: Dhakal p. 68 prints /dzudzʰlə/ “fought”; p. 75 identifies -lə as the past suffix. It is an inflection of the same jujh- stem that Turner10502 compares with eastern jujh-/jūjh- forms, so it is linked directly as a reflex, not a new derivation.
